column3: NKJV repeats “the law of righteousness,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads only “that law.”
NKJV includes “of the law” and “For,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “by works” and lacks “For.”
NKJV has “whoever,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “he who believes.”
